text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon conquers the Arima Kinen. 
However, the crowd's eyes remain entirely 
captivated by the astonishing run of the 
"Monster," Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won the race, but lost the duel... 
Feeling this way, Hishi Amazon vows to get 
her revenge against Narita Brian at next 
year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing it with her Trainer, 
Hishi Amazon set her sights on the Osaka 
Hai as her next goal. Naturally, she was 
aiming for nothing less than first 
place...!
